research_notes: Blocked: primary sources substantiate a fourteen-year public-service career, but individual employment hours, breaks and exact transfer/cessation dates remain unverified after official and conference biography searches plus first speech.
Fourteen years is a self-reported career duration, not a verified full-time headline. Contiguous year labels must be merged with proper boundaries if future evidence establishes FTE.
No private employment is documented in these sources; this is unknown rather than zero. Overseas company directors, researchers and sportspeople of the same name were not used.

Follow-up2026-10-02: official council table resolves mayoral term31 March2000 to successor20 March2002; official parliamentary profile supplies councillor1999–2004. Verified state hearing identifies final departmental portfolio on14 May2015. Added undated party offices separately.

Council direct page and PDF screenshots403; indexed official information used only for explicit facts. First state-hearing URL404 recovered through another indexed official version. Searched historical departmental records and public profiles; overseas public-service, surveying and consulting namesakes rejected.

Follow-up2026-10-03: government records add Executive Director, Urban Development observation28 September2011 and Executive Director, Regional Services observation by16 March2012/in the2011–12 annual report. These refine portfolio succession inside the official2007–2013 DPCD spell but do not establish exact transfer boundaries, substantive full-time status, leave or2016 cessation.

Next leads: individual departmental appointment/FTE/leave records and2002 public-service commencement evidence;2016 resignation date. Departmental year spans and fourteen-year narrative remain insufficient for exact full-time total.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Hill's public professional profile adds an acting Executive Director, Metropolitan Planning responsibility during departmental restructures, filling a previously generic part of the DPCD role description. The profile does not provide appointment or cessation dates, acting duration, full-time hours or leave. Targeted 2002 commencement and 2016 resignation searches otherwise repeated broad biographies; a 2018 public-administration profile only says he held the final executive-director post before election.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added five qualifications/training spells, including named Deakin2013–2015 graduate-certificate study and ANZSOG2008 program. Unlabeled professional education rows not assigned to Monash degrees or director course; uncited2000 conferral claims remain follow-up. Direct LinkedIn999 recovered via legitimate public indexed section. Other litigation/agricultural professionals, staff education and general public-service FTE counts rejected. Fourteen-year career remains without individual hours, leave/cessation and private-history proof. Next dated degree records and departmental appointment/payroll/leave evidence.

Follow-up 5 October 2026: primary federal committee record supplies a previously unspecified acting Melbourne 2030 Implementation directorship observed 16 March 2004 within DSE. Added responsibility to existing public-service spell, without additive acting duration. Targeted commencement, resignation and full-time evidence searches still lack individual contract/leave records. Current departmental FTE, other councillors part-time nursing and US football/other-professional namesakes cannot determine his hours. Council 2001/02 report direct open returned 403; existing council dates remain supported elsewhere. Departmental legal transitions are not automatically personal employment transfer dates.
